main_text.p: Framgentan, Declinare] Compofi- tum videtur à fram, de, vel à, & gan- gen, vadere, ire, proficisci : unde Am- barvalia Sax. ganzoazar.

Framgeletoon, Abduxerunt] Hæc etiam eft vox compofita ; cujus pars posterior ( prior enim ex prætmiffis patet) ejufdem videtur originis ac Saxon. læoan, unde noftrum to lead (verbum) ducere, & Leader (nomen) Dux; Du- ctor.
main_text.head: G.
main_text.p: Gajentwerde, Confpectu : & alibi gajentwajerde, & gentwert] Adver- fus, contra, Sax. tozeaner, unde za him tozeaneṛ, i.e. Ito ei obviam, vul- gò, goe meet bim. Eodem fenfu eis onzeanꝫ Altera compofiti pars, twerd, nobis hodie tward, ut in towarb, id eft, juxta, prope, &c.
Garo, Paratus : & garu, idem] Hoc Saxon. zeappe, & zeapu, à zeappian, parare, ornare, præparare ; zeapcunz, præparatio. Teuton. etiam, præparare, gaerwen ; apparare, gaer-maecken.
Galenderl, Incantantis] Talis, Sax. zaleno, & onzaleno.

page.notes: Scan is damaged at the edges and show-through is present; several words in the marginal-style entries are doubtful and may contain errors. The final entry "Galico" is set at the lower right and is treated as a catchword.
